_about: Public-domain John Ker (1819-1886, United Presbyterian, Glasgow, professor of practical training in the UP Theological Hall) for the Word Hoard: Sermons (first series, 13th ed., 1885; second series, 3rd ed., 1888), Lectures on the History of Preaching (2nd ed., 1888), Thoughts for Heart and Life (1888), The Psalms in History and Biography (1886) and Scottish Nationality and Other Papers (1887), raw Internet Archive OCR. Not the other John Kers. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
